$description: Apollo Supercharge override set (ADR-0011 + ADR-0014). Since 2026-07-22 Supercharge carries its OWN warm neutral ramp: the neutral DNA tier (color/neutral/1-15) rebinds here onto color/warm/* — page, ink, surfaces, borders and disabled greys all follow by step index. Status/RAG + dataviz stay identical to Mono (only Legacy differs). State mechanism = colour by default (registry stateMechanism; opacity only where it snaps to a warm step). Dark-mode values are index-symmetric PROPOSALS (provisional-agent, Dave review sheet 2026-07-22) — 'we can always change.' || s158-D4 (Dave, 2026-08-12) OPTION B — SINGLE SOURCE: the twelve palette-owned rag hue keys (error/warning/success/information x bare/-glyph/-background) were TRIMMED from this file; the palette file named by this theme's ragPalette in _themes.json is now their ONE source, projected by canon/gen_theme_cascade.py BEFORE the override set. Every $note that lived on those entries was relocated VERBATIM into the palette file's matching key FIRST (add-then-trim), so no ruling provenance was lost. -tint keys STAY here per s123-D3 (tints derive from per-theme grounds and are NOT palette-owned); rag/text/* stays here too. Enforced by _validate_palette_tier.py --strict-absence.

Supersedes this file's 'deliberately EMPTY' description for this one path; Supercharge ≡ Mono everywhere else.

color/neutral/4.$note: ADR-0014 ANCHOR REMAP (Dave ruled 2026-07-22: SC ink = #13110E, 'just use this we can always change'). neutral/4 is the Mono anchor step (ink = digital-black = action fill = mono/4); Supercharge's anchor is ITS step 2 — the warm ramp packs dark, so index-identity would land the anchor a shade light (warm/4 #25211C, L~33 vs mono/4 L~26). Every anchor-bound role (ink, dark page, primary action fill) follows this one line.
